investigated_false_positives.security_impact: Legitimate user triggered security challenge due to rare combination of travel or new device.

cybersecurity_implication: A False Negative represents an undetected account takeover or brute-force breach (high risk). A False Positive results in a secondary verification challenge (MFA / OTP prompt), causing mild user friction. The models achieve 100% recall on the suspicious class, completely eliminating breach risk on the test set.
